pr.body: Approach: ratelimit.py holds TokenBucket (continuous refill capped at capacity, anchored to latest clock reading so backwards clocks change nothing) and KeyedLimiter (OrderedDict of per-key buckets, LRU eviction at max_keys; try_acquire and wait_time both count as use; n and params validated before any key is created or evicted). Standard library only. Key files: ratelimit.py, test_ratelimit.py. Checks: python3 -W error -m unittest -v test_ratelimit gives 18 tests OK; py_compile OK. Assumptions: NaN capacity, rate, n and max_keys are rejected as invalid. Follow-up (non-blocking): LRU refresh by try_acquire is not directly tested; only wait_time is.
pr.summary: Rate limiter implemented. Now: TokenBucket and KeyedLimiter follow SPEC.md, including ValueError cases and LRU eviction. Before: both classes raised NotImplementedError. Now: 18 tests pass.
